description: Source code for DataFrame statistical functions in Apache Spark, including methods for approximate quantiles, covariance, correlation, crosstab, frequency items, and sampling, with internal encoders and conversions.

classes.name: DataFrameStatFunctions
classes.description: Provides statistical functions for DataFrames, such as approxQuantile, cov, corr, crosstab, freqItems, and sampleBy.

methods.name: approxQuantile
methods.description: Calculates approximate quantiles for specified columns with given probabilities and relative error.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Calculates correlation between two columns, currently only supports Pearson.

methods.name: crosstab
methods.description: Creates a cross-tabulation DataFrame for two columns.

methods.name: freqItems
methods.description: Finds frequent items in columns with optional support threshold.

methods.name: sampleBy
methods.description: Samples DataFrame rows based on fractions per stratum for a column.
